import boto3, sys, time, os
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.pop('http_proxy', None)
os.environ.pop('https_proxy', None)
os.environ.pop('HTTP_PROXY', None)
os.environ.pop('HTTPS_PROXY', None)

s3 = boto3.client('s3',
    aws_access_key_id='[REDACTED]',
    aws_secret_access_key='[REDACTED]',
    region_name='ap-northeast-1')

src = sys.argv[1]
size = Path(src).stat().st_size
key = f'manager-backup/backends/exec-sim-repair-verifier/project-archive/' + Path(src).name
print(f'Uploading {src} ({size/1024/1024:.1f} MB) -> s3://agent-ml-manager-backups-emnlp/{key}')
sys.stdout.flush()

from boto3.s3.transfer import TransferConfig
config = TransferConfig(multipart_threshold=64*1024*1024, multipart_chunksize=64*1024*1024, max_concurrency=4)

t0 = time.time()
try:
    s3.upload_file(src, 'agent-ml-manager-backups-emnlp', key, Config=config)
    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f'UPLOAD OK: {elapsed:.1f}s ({size/1024/1024/elapsed:.1f} MB/s)')
    print(f'S3 URI: s3://agent-ml-manager-backups-emnlp/{key}')
    print(f'File size: {size} bytes')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'UPLOAD FAILED: {e}')
sys.stdout.flush()
PYEOF
